projects.title: Micromouse
projects.description: Autonomous maze-solving robot built from scratch with custom PCBs. 5th place at AAMC24, 3rd at AAMC25.

projects.title: FPGA Digital Design and Verification
projects.description: Digital hardware design and verification using SystemVerilog on an Altera DE10-Lite FPGA. Built an ALU and slot machine, with custom I2C and VGA drivers.

projects.title: Slick Nick
projects.description: Fast paced, endless runner made in Unity for the Big Mode 2026 game jam. Handled much of the player controller programming, along with several models and shaders. Scored top 15% in all categories and top 10% in fun.

projects.title: Runner Boy
projects.description: Endless runner built in C# using s&box (Facepunch’s Source 2 engine). Features dynamic obstacles, score tracking, and difficulty scaling.

projects.title: ’MoreHats’ Mod
projects.description: Mod for ‘Last Train Outta Wormtown’ that adds several custom hats. Models made in Blender, packaged in Unity, and injected into the game via BepInEx.

projects.title: Terminal Task Manager
projects.description: Lightweight terminal task manager in C++. Tasks persist to a local file via a custom format and parser, with commands to add, delete, archive, and modify.

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.description: This site. Retro-styled with a Windows 7 aesthetic, built in Astro almost entirely via Claude Code.
